text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, I don't think I've changed all
that much.
I've always run for me, just
because I like doing it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But I had you and everyone else who saw
your
dreams in me, and called out to me,
and
supported me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And that's why I'm here now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! And I'll keep running a whole
lot, just
because I want to.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So keep watching. And we can dream on

together.
